description: Is this Robinhood Chain project still being built, what did it ship, what changed, is this contract its own? One cited answer. capability: research_project or builder_status (q: a name or $TICKER, or address, or project: a slug; a shared name lists candidates); what_changed (project or chain, 1–30 days); verify_project (address, project?); compare_builders (2–4, no winner); unknowns (every coverage state). Claims FACT/DERIVED/UNKNOWN with evidence ids; not_found is a status, not isError. Not price advice or a safety verdict.

address.description: A 0x contract address on Robinhood Chain.

building.description: what_changed: only events that count as building.

capability.description: Which answer; each takes the arguments the tool description names.

detail.description: Default summary text; full text; compact drops the capability data from the JSON.

limit.description: what_changed: events shown, default 25; the total is the whole window.

q.description: A name or $TICKER; a shared name lists candidates, never a guess.

types.description: what_changed: change types to keep, e.g. build.release.

name: research_answer
title: Research a Robinhood Chain project
